lr.chapter.3: The People Who Are Still Here
lr.place.lobby: A hotel lobby too large for any hotel. The hum is steady. Someone keeps it clean.
lr.place.school: Twelve classrooms, one long corridor, and a sun that is always about to set.
lr.place.pool: Enormous, tiled, quiet. The water remembers more than the walls do.
lr.place.hotel: Hundreds of doors. Most are only rooms. A few are something else.
lr.place.mall: Music from nowhere. Stores that sell afternoons.
lr.place.fields: Grass, wire and an orange sky that never gives up. The most peaceful place so far.
lr.place.lounge: Warm lamps and soft chairs. Nothing here has ever gone wrong.
lr.place.rooftop: A city that looks finished, like a drawing. No sound at all.
lr.place.train: It never moves. The fields go by anyway.
lr.place.bedroom: Small. Familiar. It seems to change when you aren't looking.
lr.place.last_room: An ordinary bedroom. One window, one bed, one door.
lr.memory.1: The first thing I remember is a hum. Warm, steady, beige.
lr.memory.2: Someone had watered the plants. I never saw who.
lr.memory.3: Room nine had the best light. We sat by the window and pretended the clock was slow.
lr.memory.4: Chalk dust looks like snow when the sun comes in at four o'clock.
lr.memory.5: I kept a key in my shoe for a whole year. I never learned what it opened.
lr.memory.6: The pool was loud once. Everyone shouting numbers, everyone counting to ten.
lr.memory.7: I could hold my breath for exactly one song. Then I came up and the world had moved on.
lr.memory.8: Under the water the noise stops. I think that is why I liked it.
lr.memory.9: Room 204. The door never locked, and I never wanted it to.
lr.memory.10: At hotels we were always arriving or leaving. Never staying.
lr.memory.11: The elevator took longer on the way down. I counted. Nobody believed me.
lr.memory.12: In the mall the music came from a place you could never find.
lr.memory.13: I won every game I played alone. After a while it stopped counting.
lr.memory.14: A paper ticket, folded in four, went through the wash. I kept it anyway.
lr.memory.15: The road went on past the last pole, and I decided that was the edge of the world.
lr.memory.16: We swung until the chains sang. Then someone called us in for dinner.
lr.memory.17: I waited for a bus I knew wasn't coming. It felt like doing something.
lr.memory.18: Home smelled like warm bread and old paper. I can't remember the street.
lr.memory.19: From the roof the city had no sound. It looked finished, like a drawing.
lr.memory.20: The train never moved, but the fields went by anyway.
lr.memory.21: My room had one window, and it always faced the evening.
lr.memory.22: I fell asleep on purpose, once, to see where the rooms went.
lr.memory.23: Some things only make sense from underneath.
lr.memory.24: There is a room behind the books. I put my worries there.
lr.memory.25: Room zero. I checked. It exists. I am not sure it exists for anyone else.
lr.memory.26: Behind the vents, the mall hums the same song as the lobby.
lr.memory.27: I buried a lunchbox under the biggest tree. Look for what grew.
lr.memory.28: The lobby was never empty. I only ever came at the hour when everyone had gone.
lr.memory.29: At the edge of the roof I stopped being afraid of the dark. It was only evening.
lr.memory.30: I hid a note under my bed: 'Don't forget the way back.'
lr.memory.31: Warm lamps. Quiet voices. I would like to stay a little longer.
lr.memory.32: Whoever you are: thank you for walking through all of it with me.
lr.npc.desc.caretaker: Keeps the rooms as they were left.
lr.npc.desc.child: Draws places before you reach them.
lr.npc.desc.wanderer: Has walked here for a very long time.
lr.npc.desc.sleeper: Resting in a perfectly ordinary bedroom.
lr.dlg.caretaker.1: Ah, there you are. Please, don't mind the hum. It means the lights are still on.
lr.dlg.caretaker.2: Every room is kept as it was left. I only dust the edges of things.
lr.dlg.caretaker.3: You're not from here. That's alright. Most visitors aren't, at first.
lr.dlg.caretaker.4: I won't tell you how to leave. Not because I mustn't. Because you'd stop looking.
lr.dlg.caretaker.5: Someone built all this out of afternoons. I only keep the doors on their hinges.
lr.dlg.caretaker.6: You've seen nearly every room. Have you noticed they all have the same window?
lr.dlg.caretaker.idle1: Mind the carpet. It remembers footsteps.
lr.dlg.caretaker.idle2: Everything is exactly where it should be. Even you.
lr.dlg.caretaker.stay: You were always here. I just hadn't introduced myself properly.
lr.dlg.child.1: I drew this for you. You haven't been there yet, but you will.
lr.dlg.child.2: Do you hear that? The classroom is trying to ring.
lr.dlg.child.3: Pools are just sky that fell down and decided to stay.
lr.dlg.child.4: I drew a hotel with too many doors. You'll know the right one.
lr.dlg.child.5: The mall has no inside. Just more outside, with a roof.
lr.dlg.child.6: I'm always the same age here. It's nice. Is it nice where you are?
lr.dlg.child.idle1: Do you want to see my drawing again?
lr.dlg.child.idle2: I'll wait here. I'm good at waiting.
lr.dlg.child.stay: You came back! I knew you would.
lr.dlg.wanderer.1: Another one. Sit, if the couches still hold you. I've lost count of how long I've been walking.
lr.dlg.wanderer.2: The rooms don't repeat. They rhyme. You'll hear it after a while.
lr.dlg.wanderer.3: I left a note at every door I understood. Most of them I wrote to myself.
lr.dlg.wanderer.4: At first I looked for the exit. Then I started looking for whoever built this.
lr.dlg.wanderer.5: Every place here is somewhere I stopped paying attention to. That's what makes it so large.
lr.dlg.wanderer.6: The Caretaker and the Child I know well. The one who sleeps, I only see from the door.
lr.dlg.wanderer.7: If you reach the last room, do me a favour. Look at the clock. Tell me if it's still on time.
lr.dlg.wanderer.idle1: Keep walking. The good rooms are always one door further.
lr.dlg.wanderer.idle2: I'm fine here. I think I'm fine here.
lr.dlg.wanderer.stay: Funny. It stopped feeling like a maze the day you stopped counting.
lr.dlg.sleeper.2: I'm not asleep. I'm just resting where the memories are warm.
lr.dlg.sleeper.3: You carried every one of them back to me. I think I remember your footsteps.
lr.dlg.sleeper.4: Whatever you choose, nothing here will be lost. It was always going to be kept.
lr.puzzle.lobby_symbols.done: The directory lights up. Somewhere, a door was waiting for this.
lr.puzzle.school_classroom.done: This was the room. The window faces the evening.
lr.puzzle.school_lockers.done: A locker opens. Inside: a brass key.
lr.puzzle.pool_sequence.done: The tiles hum back at you.
lr.puzzle.pool_drain.done: The drain opens onto a quiet passage below.
lr.puzzle.hotel_elevator.done: The elevator hums. It likes that order.
lr.puzzle.hotel_loop.done: The corridor finally lets you go.
lr.puzzle.mall_arcade.done: All five screens flicker, then agree.
lr.puzzle.mall_shop.done: The shop opens. A ticket was waiting on the counter.
lr.puzzle.train_ticket.done: The slot accepts the ticket. The doors begin to close.
lr.puzzle.fields_poles.done: The wires sing one clear note.
lr.puzzle.last_clock.done: The clock is on time. It was always on time.
lr.note.lobby_desk: A guest book. The last entry is today's date, in handwriting you almost recognise.
lr.note.library: A reading slip: 'The lockers open for those who count from the entrance: the third, then the eighth, then the fifth.'
lr.note.class_wrong.1: The chairs are all turned toward the window. Nothing here.
lr.note.class_wrong.2: A faded timetable. Every period says 'Afternoon'.
lr.note.class_wrong.3: Someone drew a sun on the board and never wiped it.
lr.note.pool_poster: A faded poster: 'SWIM IN ORDER: blue, yellow, red, green.'
lr.note.hotel_elevator: A guest note: 'I always press three, then one, then four. The elevator likes it that way.'
lr.note.hotel_loop: A note: 'If the corridor repeats, trust your right hand, then your left, then your right.'
lr.note.arcade: A high-score board: 'Second, then fourth, then first, then third.' No initials.
lr.note.bus_stop: A timetable scratched with pen: 'Start with the middle pole, then the first, then the last, then the second. Listen.'
lr.note.lounge_books: Every spine is blank, except one: 'Don't forget the way back.'
lr.note.bedroom_desk: A page of homework. The answer to every question is 'home'. In the margin: 'The clock: second, fourth, first, third.'
lr.note.last_remember_locked: The desk drawer is stuck. You haven't remembered enough yet.
lr.note.last_window_locked: The window looks painted on. Something about it is still missing.
lr.msg.locked.school: The door stays shut. Perhaps someone here can explain.
lr.msg.locked.pool: The pool door is locked. The school isn't finished with you.
lr.msg.locked.hotel: The way to the hotel is closed. There is still something under the pool.
lr.msg.locked.mall: The elevator doesn't move. The hotel isn't finished with you.
lr.msg.locked.lounge: Not yet. Someone should speak to you first.
lr.msg.locked.rooftop: The stairs lead nowhere until the hotel is understood.
lr.msg.locked.bedroom: This door is only a wall, for now.
lr.msg.reset: Nothing happens. The order was wrong.
lr.msg.need_key: The door is locked. You need a brass key.
lr.msg.panel: The directory shows three symbols you haven't found yet.
lr.msg.loop: The corridor folds back on itself.
lr.msg.ride.2: Fields slide past the window, slower than they should.
lr.msg.ride.3: The light is orange. It will be orange for a long time.
lr.end.wake.2: The window is bright, and ordinary.
lr.end.stay.3: You stay, and the evening stays with you.
lr.end.remember.1: The lobby was the first room you ever walked out of.
lr.end.remember.2: The school, the pool, the mall: small afternoons you kept.
lr.end.remember.3: The Caretaker is your habit of keeping. The Child, who you were. The Wanderer, who you feared becoming.
lr.end.remember.4: And the Sleeper is simply you, resting until you were ready to remember.
lr.end.window.2: The evening is not outside. It is where you were standing all along.
lr.end.window.3: You were never trapped. You were visiting.
